title: Los 3 cerditos
subtitle: Un cuento clásico
cover_svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 800 600" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><rect width="800" height="600" fill="#dceefb"/><ellipse cx="400" cy="610" rx="500" ry="150" fill="#b8d994"/><rect x="120" y="320" width="120" height="120" fill="#f2d98a"/><path d="M120 320 L180 260 L240 320 Z" fill="#e59d38"/><rect x="340" y="320" width="120" height="120" fill="#c98d5a"/><path d="M340 320 L400 260 L460 320 Z" fill="#8b5a2b"/><rect x="560" y="320" width="120" height="120" fill="#d9534f"/><path d="M560 320 L620 260 L680 320 Z" fill="#a94442"/><circle cx="620" cy="200" r="40" fill="#8b5a2b"/></svg>

pages.text: Tres cerditos construyeron sus casas: una de paja, una de madera y una de ladrillos.
pages.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 800 600" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><rect width="800" height="600" fill="#dceefb"/><ellipse cx="400" cy="615" rx="520" ry="150" fill="#b8d994"/><rect x="120" y="320" width="120" height="120" fill="#f2d98a"/><path d="M120 320 L180 260 L240 320 Z" fill="#e59d38"/><rect x="340" y="320" width="120" height="120" fill="#c98d5a"/><path d="M340 320 L400 260 L460 320 Z" fill="#8b5a2b"/><rect x="560" y="320" width="120" height="120" fill="#d9534f"/><path d="M560 320 L620 260 L680 320 Z" fill="#a94442"/></svg>

pages.text: El lobo sopló y derribó la casa de paja.
pages.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 800 600" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><rect width="800" height="600" fill="#cfe7f8"/><ellipse cx="400" cy="615" rx="520" ry="150" fill="#b8d994"/><rect x="150" y="360" width="140" height="100" fill="#f2d98a" transform="rotate(15 220 410)"/><circle cx="500" cy="300" r="60" fill="#8b5a2b"/><path d="M440 280 L380 260 M440 320 L380 340" stroke="#8b5a2b" stroke-width="12" stroke-linecap="round"/></svg>

pages.text: El lobo sopló y derribó la casa de madera.
pages.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 800 600" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><rect width="800" height="600" fill="#cfe7f8"/><ellipse cx="400" cy="615" rx="520" ry="150" fill="#b8d994"/><rect x="150" y="360" width="140" height="100" fill="#c98d5a" transform="rotate(-10 220 410)"/><circle cx="500" cy="300" r="60" fill="#8b5a2b"/><path d="M440 280 L380 260 M440 320 L380 340" stroke="#8b5a2b" stroke-width="12" stroke-linecap="round"/></svg>

pages.text: El lobo sopló y sopló, pero la casa de ladrillos no se movió. ¡Los cerditos estaban a salvo!
pages.svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 800 600" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><rect width="800" height="600" fill="#dceefb"/><ellipse cx="400" cy="615" rx="520" ry="150" fill="#b8d994"/><rect x="300" y="300" width="200" height="160" fill="#d9534f"/><path d="M300 300 L400 230 L500 300 Z" fill="#a94442"/><circle cx="400" cy="380" r="20" fill="#f2b64f"/><circle cx="150" cy="300" r="50" fill="#8b5a2b"/><path d="M110 290 L70 280 M110 310 L70 320" stroke="#8b5a2b" stroke-width="10" stroke-linecap="round"/></svg>

end_text: Solo con esfuerzo se consiguen las cosas. Fin.
